compact_output.description: Flag string to append to the command when 'output_style' is set to compact.

digits.description: Number of significant digits in output, corresponding to the --digits command-line option.

env_overrides.description: List of environment variable overrides to set for the units process, such as UNITS_SYSTEM or UNITS_ENGLISH.

env_overrides.items.description: A key-value pair string in the format 'KEY=VALUE'.

locale.description: Locale to force for localized unit definitions (e.g., 'en_GB' for British Imperial units).

log_file.description: Path to a log file to record interactive calculation history. Empty string disables logging.

log_flag.description: Command-line flag for specifying the log file.

output_style.description: Preferred output style: 'verbose' for human-readable labels, 'compact' for minimal output, or 'terse' for machine-parseable single-line output.

strict_mode.description: If true, suppresses reciprocal unit conversion (e.g., Hz to seconds) and enforces strict conformability.

terse_output.description: Flag string to append to the command when 'output_style' is set to terse.

unit_system.description: Alternative unit system to use (e.g., 'gaussian', 'esu', 'planck'). Empty string or 'si' uses default SI.

unit_system_flag.description: Command-line flag for selecting the unit system.

units_file.description: Path to a custom units definition file. Empty string uses the default system definitions.

units_file_flag.description: Command-line flag for specifying a custom units file.

verbose_output.description: Flag string to append to the command when 'output_style' is set to verbose.
